description: Four two-input AND gates ORed together and the result inverted: the output is high only while no pair has both of its inputs high.

inputs.text: One of the two inputs of one pair; the output drops to 0V as soon as both inputs of any pair are high.
Forces the output to 0V while this is high; patch another CD4086 output here to make a wider gate. Unpatched it counts as low.
Forces the output to 0V while this is low. With nothing patched it reads 10V, so the gate works on its own.

outputs.text: 10V only while the enable input is high, the inhibit input is low, and no pair of inputs has both of its inputs high.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.
